Research and retry subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-tax.md, BRIEF-tax-retry.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page.

figures.finding: For 2026 an Ecuadorian resident pays nothing on taxable income up to US$12,208, then 5%, 10%, 12%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 30%, 35%, and 37% above US$109,956; there is no local income tax.

sources.said: There are no local (provincial, county, or municipal) taxes on income.

figures.finding: A private employee pays 9.45% of remuneration to social security and the employer 12.15%; a voluntary contributor (self-employed) pays 17.6% of income.

sources.said: Private employees under a labour relationship will contribute at the rate of 9.45% of remuneration arising from employment
Voluntary contributors must pay a rate of 17.6% over their income. The employer contribution amounts to 12.15% of total remuneration.

figures.finding: The employer withholds income tax monthly where the employee's annual net income exceeds US$12,208, and its annual withholding return stands as the employee's return.

sources.said: In the case of employees, there is mandatory monthly withholding by the employer as long as the total annual net income exceeds the non-taxable base of USD 12,208.
The employer's annual withholding return is considered the employee's income tax return.

figures.finding: A non-resident pays 25% income tax, withheld at source, on Ecuador-source income; payments to a non-resident occasionally working in Ecuador not charged to an Ecuadorian company or branch give rise to no tax.

sources.said: Non-residents are subject to 25% income tax on income received from local sources, which is withheld at source. Payments made to non-residents occasionally working in Ecuador, when not charged to an Ecuadorian company or branch of a foreign entity, do not give rise to income tax.

figures.finding: Services under a professional fee contract bear 15% VAT (wholly withheld when supplied to companies), and the professional files VAT returns; employment bears none.

sources.said: Personal services provided under a professional fee contract relationship are subject to VAT at 15%, which, when provided to companies, is subject to 100% withholding by them. Professionals are required to file VAT returns.

figures.finding: The fiscal year is the calendar year; individuals other than employees file in March of the following year, on a day set by the ninth digit of the tax number.

sources.said: The fiscal year is the calendar year.
Other individuals must file their income tax return in March of the following year.
